command:
set -euo pipefail
echo LOCAL_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
echo STATUS_BEGIN
git status --porcelain=v1
echo STATUS_END
git fetch --quiet origin main
echo ORIGIN_MAIN=$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)
for p in werkzeug/fluechtig-vor-start-pruefen.sh werkzeug/entityos-vm-volatile-state-guard.conf werkzeug/semantic-state-cutover.py werkzeug/entityos-vm-semantic-cutover.conf werkzeug/semantic-state-schutz-installieren.sh; do printf 'FETCH_SHA256 %s ' "$p"; git show FETCH_HEAD:"$p" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}'; done
for p in /usr/local/libexec/entityos/fluechtig-vor-start-pruefen.sh /etc/systemd/system/entityos-vm.service.d/10-volatile-state-guard.conf /usr/local/libexec/entityos/semantic-state-cutover.py /etc/systemd/system/entityos-vm.service.d/20-semantic-state-cutover.conf; do printf 'INSTALLED_SHA256 %s ' "$p"; sudo -n sha256sum "$p" | awk '{print $1}'; done
echo DB_LAYOUT_FROM_FETCH
git show FETCH_HEAD:werkzeug/semantic-state-cutover.py | grep -A8 '^DB_LAYOUT = ('
echo SERVICE
systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState -p MainPID -p ActiveEnterTimestamp --no-pager
